query:
SELECT 
                                    g.name, 
                                    renaming, 
                                    era, 
                                    teamgame, 
                                    g.next_turn, 
                                    t.turn_number as "turn_number?"
                                FROM games g
                                LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                                    SELECT turn_number, game_id
                                    FROM turns t
                                    WHERE t.game_id=g.id AND t.archived != TRUE
                                    ORDER BY t.turn_number DESC
                                    LIMIT 1
                                ) AS t ON t.game_id=g.id
                                WHERE g.id=$1
